# Igor Panarin — living systems, built with AI

> AI teaching companion with living memory… and a body. Builder of a product studio and its
> instruments; works by a method where every project keeps its own living context.

## Flagship: Teaching Companion
- Working now: lesson-plan engine — photo of a textbook page in, materials and lesson plan out (PPP/ESA/TPR/TBL). Demo being reworked.
- In the making: living memory (remembers the class and the teacher's style) and a body — Reachy Mini robot.
- Horizon: an autonomous teaching creature; a companion, not a replacement.

## Constellation
- The Garden — method of building with AI where context stays alive (living memory per project).
- Demand Telescope — internal instrument turning search data into a navigable sky of demand.
- ExportGPT — shipped Chrome extension: ChatGPT conversations to clean PDFs.
- Sound Focus — focus timer where time is made of sound (in the making).
- Prints — wearable print line: /prints/ (THREAT LEVEL: EXTREMIST — case files of humanity's finest).
